sentences.en: What is most troublesome is the corruption of the best.
sentences.zh: 最令人担忧的是优秀人才的堕落。

sentences.en: A man of strong will is not subject to corruption.
sentences.zh: 意志坚强的人不会被腐蚀。

sentences.en: The new government promised to rid the country of corruption.
sentences.zh: 新政府承诺要让国家摆脱腐败。

senses.zh: 腐败，贪污；堕落，腐化；腐烂，烂坏；篡改，损坏

mnemonic: 词根记忆：cor（加强）+rupt（破）+ion（表状态）→破坏组织肌体→腐烂
